integrity: The proof reconstructs the source affine hull from the layer functional, computes the orthogonal projection of the ambient origin, derives the common vertex radius exactly, proves a necessary-and-sufficient minimum-sphere criterion by convex averaging and strict separation, and reduces the standard bipartite case to an exact max-flow/min-cut condition. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Euclidean root-vector realization of connected semi-balanced directed graphs with at least three vertices. It gives the exact canonical all-vertex sphere and a necessary-and-sufficient condition for that sphere to be the minimum enclosing sphere. When the condition fails, the smaller true radius is not computed. The simple Hall form is asserted only for the standard two-layer bipartite orientation.
title: Semi-balanced root polytopes have a canonical vertex sphere with a flow criterion for minimality
